added: Collection selection mode has Select all, which picks every dance in the list you are looking at (and Deselect all to undo it). On a narrow screen it is the first entry of More batch actions.
When a search hides dances you had selected, the line under the search says how many (for example "14 selected (9 not shown)") and offers Deselect those not shown.
changed: Turning on Online search now ends selection mode instead of leaving a hidden selection behind.
A selected dance that is deleted, or removed by another device, now leaves the selection instead of still being counted.
